abilities.name: Viking Hoard
abilities.description: Gathering a Regeneration Globe with a Viking permanently increases all their Health Regeneration by 0.5 per second.; trait

fields.notes: Each Regeneration Globe only counts as 1 stack, even if it's collected by multiple Vikings.

abilities.name: Select Olaf
abilities.description: Olaf can charge enemies and Slow their Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds by right-clicking on them. 8 second cooldown. Olaf gains increased Health Regeneration when out of combat for 4 seconds. Charge Stoutness

fields.notes: Targeting an enemy below the minimum range will not initiate Charge, and causes Olaf to Basic Attack them normally. Attack orders issued while Silenced will never trigger the charge, Olaf will simply walk all the way up and Basic Attack normally instead. If Olaf is mid-charge when Play Again triggers from another Viking, he will continue his charge globally, either flying all the way to and hitting his target or returning to the start location of the charge, depending on the part of the animation he is in when Play Again completes.

abilities.name: Select Baleog
abilities.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks deal 50% splash damage to enemies behind his attack target.

abilities.name: Longboat Raid!
abilities.description: Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 damage in an area. The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds. yellowtext Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby. Longboat

fields.notes: Longboat's attacks are siege attacks that deal Spell Damage. Longboat's attacks prioritize Heroes, then the closest enemy.

abilities.name: Longboat Raid! - Mortar
abilities.description: Fires a mortar at the targeted location, dealing 228 damage in a large area.

fields.notes: Available during Longboat Raid! . Mortar projectile has a flight time of 0.3, 1.0 or 1.5 seconds, depending on the distance to the target point.

abilities.name: Play Again!
abilities.description: Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds. yellowtext Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

fields.notes: Placed on a 10 second cooldown if interrupted. Vikings in Stasis at the end of the channel will not be healed or teleported to the cast location.

abilities.name: Go Go Go!
abilities.description: The Vikings gain 30% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Select Erik
talents.description: Erik moves faster than the other Vikings and has increased Basic Attack range. False
_raw_fields: Erik moves faster than the other Vikings and has increased Basic Attack range.

talents.name: Select All Vikings
talents.description: The Lost Vikings can be controlled individually or as a group. Each Viking has particular strengths. False
_raw_fields: The Lost Vikings can be controlled individually or as a group. Each Viking has particular strengths.

talents.name: Olaf the Stout
talents.description: Passive Olaf gains 20% bonus maximum Health. Every 5 seconds, Olaf gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 2 charges.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Passive Olaf gains 20% bonus maximum Health. Every 5 seconds, Olaf gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 2 charges.

talents.name: Spy Games
talents.description: After standing still for 3 seconds, Erik gains Stealth and his Sight Radius is increased by 75%. The Stealth persists for 3 seconds after moving and once removed, Erik gains 75% bonus Basic Attack damage for 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Erik's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: After standing still for 3 seconds, Erik gains Stealth and his Sight Radius is increased by 75%. The Stealth persists for 3 seconds after moving and once removed, Erik gains 75% bonus Basic Attack damage for 6 seconds.

talents.name: Explosive Attacks
talents.description: Increases Baleog’s splash damage against non-Heroes to 100%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Baleog's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Increases Baleog’s splash damage against non-Heroes to 100%.

talents.name: Viking Bribery
talents.description: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

fields.notes: Players from either team can see the exact number of stacks for this Talent currently available by hovering over the icon on the Talents screen.

_raw_fields: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

talents.name: Pain Don't Hurt
talents.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks and splash damage heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing is doubled against Heroes.
_raw_fields: Baleog's Basic Attacks and splash damage heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

talents.name: Erik The Swift
talents.description: Permanently increases Erik's base Movement Speed by 10%, and as long as Erik is moving he heals 34 Health per second.

fields.notes: You can use shift to queue up Erik to run back and forth in a small area and therefore passively heal while you control another Viking. Movement Speed bonus is an increase to Erik's base Movement Speed, causing it to stack multiplicatively with the highest Movement Speed buff affecting him.

_raw_fields: Permanently increases Erik's base Movement Speed by 10%, and as long as Erik is moving he heals 34 Health per second.

talents.name: It's a Sabotage!
talents.description: Erik's Basic Attacks against Structures light them on fire for 3 seconds, causing 225 damage.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Reapplying the effect refreshes the duration.

_raw_fields: Erik's Basic Attacks against Structures light them on fire for 3 seconds, causing 225 damage.

talents.name: Mercenary Lord
talents.description: Friendly non-Boss Mercenaries near your Hero deal 50% more damage. Gain 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

fields.notes: Damage bonus does not stack with other Mercenary Lord auras and its derivatives. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects against Minions and Mercenaries. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Friendly non-Boss Mercenaries near your Hero deal 50% more damage. Gain 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

talents.name: Baleog the Fierce
talents.description: Increase Baleog’s attack range by 2.5. While near Olaf and Erik, he becomes inspired by the power of teamwork and his Attack Speed is increased by 50%.
_raw_fields: Increase Baleog’s attack range by 2.5. While near Olaf and Erik, he becomes inspired by the power of teamwork and his Attack Speed is increased by 50%.

talents.description: cooldown 10 Activate to have each Viking deal 85 damage to nearby enemies. Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

fields.notes: Hero bonus stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Spin To Win! 's damage.

fields.notes: Cannot be activated if Stunned, Silenced, or in Stasis, except you can select a Viking which isn't so impaired and press W to immediately free all 3 Vikings with this Talent.

talents.name: Nordic Attack Squad
talents.description: While Olaf, Baleog, and Erik are near each of the other Vikings, their Basic Attacks deal bonus damage equal to 1.25% maximum Health to enemy Heroes.

talents.description: Activating Go Go Go! grants an additional 40% Movement Speed and breaks the Vikings out of Roots and Slows.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with baseline Go Go Go! Movement Speed bonus, but not with other Movement Speed bonuses.

talents.name: Executioner
talents.description: Attacking a Hero who is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: The effect triggers separately on each Viking. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Vikings' Basic Attack damage.
